title: 1971: The Day Money Became a Promise

music.source: YouTube Audio Library, chosen by Shubham

shorts.hook: Your $100 bill used to buy almost 5 ounces of gold. Now it buys a fortieth. What broke?
shorts.cta: So what replaced gold in your wallet?

shorts.hook: Before coins, you could lose a whole day trading chickens for one goat. Why did gold end up as money?
shorts.cta: Then gold got too heavy to carry.

shorts.hook: 1,000 years ago, your savings in China cost you a backpack of iron. So why did paper win, and what broke?
shorts.cta: Then Europe chained paper to gold.

shorts.hook: You could risk 10 years in prison for keeping gold in 1933. But why?
shorts.cta: So what did 1971 do to your dollar?

shorts.hook: Your dollar's gold promise started cracking in 1965. Why did France want 300 million dollars in gold?
shorts.cta: Three years later, Nixon shut the gold window.

shorts.hook: Your money lost its last link to gold on August 15th, 1971. What happened that Sunday?
shorts.cta: So why does the world still run on dollars?

shorts.hook: Why do you still pay in dollars, 50 years after gold left? Blame your family group chat.
shorts.cta: But central banks are quietly buying gold again.

shorts.hook: Why can't you just go back to gold? All 222,600 tonnes would cost you more than you think.
shorts.cta: So what actually backs your money today?
